🍝 Quick Pasta Carbonara Recipe!

Ingredients:
- 400g spaghetti
- 200g pancetta or bacon, diced
- 4 large eggs
- 100g Parmesan cheese, grated
- Black pepper to taste
- Salt for pasta water

Instructions:
1. Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water according to package directions
2. While pasta cooks, fry pancetta until crispy
3. Beat eggs with Parmesan and lots of black pepper
4. Drain pasta (save 1 cup pasta water)
5. Toss hot pasta with pancetta, remove from heat
6. Quickly stir in egg mixture, adding pasta water to create creamy sauce
7. Serve immediately with extra Parmesan!
